changelog:
Security update: DensAssistant no longer trusts the compromised eMudhra certificate authorities.

In October 2026 the private keys of eight eMudhra certificate authorities leaked. Browsers and Windows block them, but the app checked some connections against the Windows root store, which still accepted them. Update checks, model downloads and your Google, Microsoft and cloud-brain connections now check against the certificate list built into the app, which has the compromised authorities removed.

Includes 0.1.72: ask about one meeting, and remove action items that don't apply to you.
